searchability.rendered_all_fields_note: All fields is a broad analyzed metadata query, not an exact taxonomy-ID filter.

searchability.atom_category_scope: The official search source's cat: query checks exact primary or secondary category IDs; use id_list for known-version retrieval.

explosion.root_behavior: The rendered group/archive controls naturally include descendant classification IDs, but this is source scope filtering, not a user-selectable explode flag.
explosion.leaf_behavior: No documented automatic descendant expansion for cat:<leaf>.

focus.note: No focus/major-topic query or result control is exposed.

major_topic.general_flag_note: The source has is_general metadata for broad catch-all categories; it is not a major-topic ranking/facet or expansion instruction.

browse.cross_list_behavior: An article cross-listed to a category appears in that category's regular listing in its cross-list section.
browse.taxonomy_source: The public category page is the browse hierarchy and scope-note source.

advanced_search.subject_controls: Fixed archive/group controls, not a dynamically generated leaf facet.
advanced_search.result_facets: No category aggregation/result facet was exposed by the current route.
advanced_search.query_echo: The result page echoes selected source controls but does not turn them into facets.

exact_query_syntax.atom_url_encoding: URL-encode spaces, parentheses, and quotes; preserve the category ID case/punctuation.
exact_query_syntax.version_retrieval: id_list=<bare-id> or id_list=<bare-id>vN; do not use id:<id> for version-sensitive retrieval.

stable_codes.representation: case-sensitive-looking textual IDs such as cs.LG and astro-ph.CO; no numeric taxonomy IDs are published.
stable_codes.stable_scope: Exact within a captured taxonomy/source revision.
stable_codes.case_rule: Typed category codes must use the exact source spelling and punctuation.
known_change_mechanisms: defunct archives subsumed by subject categories
stable_codes.recording_rule: Retain the exact source category term, primary/secondary role, scheme, and version; canonicalize only as a separately labelled derived value.

known_item_effects.meaning: A selected archive root includes a matching secondary only when cross-lists are included.
Excluding cross-lists does not remove a paper whose selected archive is primary.
The documented alias math.MP is not an observed Atom cat: synonym for canonical math-ph.
A historical record can retain the inactive bare cond-mat category code; the current cond-mat Physics archive is still an active UI scope, so reject the code only for typed leaf/category rows.
